sources.title: Deuterium-Based Plasmas as a Source for Helium-3
sources.status: SOURCE-TRACED theoretical study; abstract accessed; full text not obtained
sources.used: Approximately 70% recoverable He3 in studied driven SCD plasmas; approximately 80% ignited-plasma bound; respective 70 and 50 MeV fusion energy per recovered atom
sources.transfer_limit: Plasma conditions and recovery boundary cannot be reconstructed from abstract. Not a downstream equipment efficiency or ARC validation. 2017 online posting is not original publication year.

sources.author: Lily Hale, Fuel Cycle Team Manager, Helion Energy
sources.title: How to engineer a renewable deuterium-helium-3 fusion fuel cycle
sources.locator: Engineering the fuel cycle; Demonstrating the complete fuel cycle
sources.used: Direct DD and tritium-decay pathways; separation and getter storage interfaces
sources.transfer_limit: Pulsed FRC fuel recycling differs from ARC tokamak exhaust. No transferable measured overall He3 recovery supplied.

sources.author: Bryce Alexander, Fuel Cycle Manager, Helion Energy
sources.title: Fusion fuel: where does it go after fusion occurs?
sources.locator: Exhaust is analyzed; Separation; Recycling fuel
sources.used: Diagnostic accountancy, separate hydrogen/helium/impurity streams, helium isotope separation, present batch and proposed continuous operation
sources.transfer_limit: Listed methods are not a qualified Beyond Q process flowsheet or quantified capture/purity guarantee.

sources.title: Advanced fuel cycle and fusion reactors utilizing the same
sources.locator: Bibliographic header; Summary; Detailed description; claims
sources.used: DD He3/T production, pulsed extraction before DT consumption, tritium storage/decay and later reuse
sources.transfer_limit: Does not demonstrate reactor operation, determine ARC integration, or establish patentability/freedom to operate. Do not import its approximate 11-year decay wording into the 12.32-year model.

sources.author: Kronos Fusion Energy, Inc.
sources.title: The fuel cycle, in depth
sources.locator: Breeder fuel; main fuel-cycle paragraph; correction note
sources.status: SOURCE-TRACED company concept and projected quantities
sources.used: Purpose-built DT breeder and D-He3 burner; aging T inventory; about 4 kg/year T and 1.97 kg/year He3 company figures
sources.transfer_limit: The page does not reconcile the aging inventory and time origin for the quoted flow. TBR scan values are design assumptions. Not direct-DD He3 or demonstrated output.

sources.title: Power and particle exhaust for the ARC fusion power plant
sources.publication: Journal of Plasma Physics 92(3), E66, June 2026
sources.used: Helium exhaust interface; proposed transport/SPARC validation; direct internal recycling as a possible improvement
sources.transfer_limit: DT He4 ash exhaust is not DD He3 product recovery. Equation 5.4 printed rate discrepancy retained in report. No 37.5/75/90% product efficiency follows from ash concentration.
